import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from datetime import datetime

# Create DataFrame from provided data
data = {
    'ID': [5524, 2174, 4141, 6182, 5324],
    'Year_Birth': [1957, 1954, 1965, 1984, 1981],
    'Education': ['Graduation', 'Graduation', 'Graduation', 'Graduation', 'PhD'],
    'Marital_Status': ['Single', 'Single', 'Together', 'Together', 'Married'],
    'Income': [58138.0, 46344.0, 71613.0, 26646.0, 58293.0],
    'Kidhome': [0, 1, 0, 1, 1],
    'Teenhome': [0, 1, 0, 0, 0],
    'Dt_Customer': ['04-09-2012', '08-03-2014', '21-08-2013', '10-02-2014', '19-01-2014'],
    'Recency': [58, 38, 26, 26, 94],
    'MntWines': [635, 11, 426, 11, 173],
    'MntFruits': [88, 1, 49, 4, 43],
    'MntMeatProducts': [546, 6, 127, 20, 118],
    'MntFishProducts': [172, 2, 111, 10, 46],
    'MntSweetProducts': [88, 1, 21, 3, 27],
    'MntGoldProds': [88, 6, 42, 5, 15],
    'NumDealsPurchases': [3, 2, 1, 2, 5],
    'NumWebPurchases': [8, 1, 8, 2, 5],
    'NumCatalogPurchases': [10, 1, 2, 0, 3],
    'NumStorePurchases': [4, 2, 10, 4, 6],
    'NumWebVisitsMonth': [7, 5, 4, 6, 5],
    'AcceptedCmp3': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'AcceptedCmp4': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'AcceptedCmp5': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'AcceptedCmp1': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'AcceptedCmp2': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'Complain': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'Z_CostContact': [3, 3, 3, 3, 3],
    'Z_Revenue': [11, 11, 11, 11, 11],
    'Response': [1, 0, 0, 0, 0]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Calculate age from Year_Birth
current_year = datetime.now().year
df['Age'] = current_year - df['Year_Birth']

# Calculate total spending
spending_cols = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 
                 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
df['Total_Spending'] = df[spending_cols].sum(axis=1)

# Calculate total purchases
purchase_cols = ['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases']
df['Total_Purchases'] = df[purchase_cols].sum(axis=1)

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Income vs Total Spending scatter plot
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
scatter = ax1.scatter(df['Income'], df['Total_Spending'], 
                      c=df['Age'], s=df['Total_Purchases']*50, 
                      alpha=0.7, cmap='viridis')
ax1.set_xlabel('Income ($)')
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Spending ($)')
ax1.set_title('Income vs Total Spending\n(Size = Total Purchases, Color = Age)')
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax1, label='Age')

# 2. Age distribution
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
bars = ax2.bar(range(len(df)), df['Age'], color=sns.color_palette("husl", len(df)))
ax2.set_xlabel('Customer Index')
ax2.set_ylabel('Age')
ax2.set_title('Customer Age Distribution')
ax2.set_xticks(range(len(df)))
ax2.set_xticklabels(df['ID'])

# 3. Spending by category (stacked bar)
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
categories = spending_cols
category_data = df[categories].values.T
bottom = None
for i, category in enumerate(categories):
    ax3.bar(range(len(df)), category_data[i], bottom=bottom, 
            label=category.replace('Mnt', '').replace('Prods', ''), 
            alpha=0.8)
    if bottom is None:
        bottom = category_data[i]
    else:
        bottom += category_data[i]
ax3.set_xlabel('Customer Index')
ax3.set_ylabel('Spending ($)')
ax3.set_title('Spending by Category')
ax3.set_xticks(range(len(df)))
ax3.set_xticklabels(df['ID'])
ax3.legend(bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# 4. Purchase channels comparison
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
channels = ['Web', 'Catalog', 'Store']
channel_data = [df['NumWebPurchases'].sum(), 
                df['NumCatalogPurchases'].sum(), 
                df['NumStorePurchases'].sum()]
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(channel_data, labels=channels, autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                   startangle=90, colors=sns.color_palette("Set2"))
ax4.set_title('Purchase Channel Distribution')

# 5. Customer metrics heatmap
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
metrics = ['Income', 'Total_Spending', 'Total_Purchases', 'Recency', 'Age']
metrics_data = df[metrics]
# Normalize for better visualization
normalized_data = (metrics_data - metrics_data.min()) / (metrics_data.max() - metrics_data.min())
sns.heatmap(normalized_data.T, annot=metrics_data.T.values, fmt='.0f',
            cmap='YlOrRd', cbar_kws={'label': 'Normalized Value'},
            ax=ax5, xticklabels=df['ID'], yticklabels=metrics)
ax5.set_title('Customer Metrics Comparison')
ax5.set_xlabel('Customer ID')

# 6. Family composition
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
family_data = pd.DataFrame({
    'Kids': df['Kidhome'],
    'Teens': df['Teenhome'],
    'Total_Children': df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome']
})
family_data.index = df['ID']
family_data.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax6, width=0.8)
ax6.set_xlabel('Customer ID')
ax6.set_ylabel('Number of Children')
ax6.set_title('Family Composition')
ax6.legend(title='Child Type')

plt.suptitle('Customer Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
